component: Thunderbird unified-folder account color data flow

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Cards request accountCol and serverKeyCol separately. Native column dispatch fetches the incoming-server key from the message folder. The card uses that key for its CSS custom-property reference and the display name only for the title. Folder indicators use the same server-key naming. The view-class predicate is limited to synthetic/smart/tag contexts; it does not cover every virtual folder. This establishes source data flow, not a benchmark, visual result or all-message traversal guarantee.
title: Unified message indicators use the incoming-server key for color identity
